jobs.description:
Are you a confident decision maker and problem solver? Do you lead by example? Do you enjoy problem solving and have the ability to influence people around you in a positive and professional way? We’re looking for someone like you that can:

• Serve as deputy to the Wealth Advice Center Operations Managers by assisting with the daily review of items including client money movement, trades, new account approvals, client correspondence, and trade error correction
• Ensure branch Operations Personnel are addressing service requests from our 40+ Client Service Associates, 250+ Financial Advisors, and ~200,000+ clients in a timely and efficient manner
• Train and develop new Operations team members as they join the Wealth Advice Center platform
• Identify and escalate the resolution of urgent client service issues
• Drive and execute various business initiatives that are in line with the WAC’s growth plan
• Promote a culture of ongoing learning & development
• Implement service excellence standards, including coaching and educating operational Support Staff on the Client Experience best practices and suitability

jobs.title: GWM AML Advisor
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned risk manager and can provide challenge to senior management in their risk decisions? Do you enjoy working in teams and contribute to the sustainable risk management of the business? Then we are looking for someone like you!

In your new role you will:
• Provide 1st line advice and policy interpretation to Markets on AML related matters in line with regulatory expectations and global/regional policies, framework and guidance; assisting Markets with the articulation and assessment of AML risks to guide Markets in their decision making.
• Provide 1st line guidance to Markets on Level 2 queries2 for individual cases, providing practical advice and potential solutions to address identified AML/CFT risks for individual cases. Where needed, supporting Markets in their discussions with DDO on escalated Level 2 cases on a prioritized basis.
• Partner with OH and C&ORC to uplift Markets capabilities on AML/CFT topics by developing materials (e.g. scenario guidance), providing relevant training, sharing feedback through lessons learnt, and sharing of industry best practices.
• Support Markets from a 1st line risk perspective in timely completion of remediation programs, including, where appropriate, providing appropriate management reporting and advice around risks, issues & dependencies.
• present key updates to management including risks, issues & dependencies in appropriate forums and provide guidance on mitigation
• be a role model to your team of risk partners
• help drive a positive risk culture throughout the organization including driving and delivering selected trainings

jobs.title: Global Markets Client Office EMEA
jobs.description:
As part of Global Markets Client Office, you will help shape and deliver our client strategy across Global Markets Distribution—driving revenue outperformance, winning market share and improving the client experience.
You’ll act as a central connector between clients and the firm, ensuring we bring the full UBS platform to clients without silo bias. You will put the client at the centre of decision making: identifying share of wallet gaps, prioritising the right opportunities, and turning insight into measurable commercial outcomes.
You will work at the intersection of data, AI, sales, trading and senior management—translating analytics into action through disciplined forums, campaigns and best in class execution. Inform. Enable. Execute.

In this role, you will:
• drive cross asset client campaigns and regional initiatives for priority clients—spot opportunities, coordinate execution and track outcomes
• deliver clear, large scale analytics on wallet gaps, campaign performance and thematic trends to inform strategy and improve results
• act as the Voice of the Client by running structured internal client reviews and forums with Sales & Trading and senior stakeholders—capturing insights, agreeing actions and ensuring follow through
• support key client deliverables across account management (firm to firm engagement, new PM onboarding, strategic discussions, escalations and ongoing connectivity)
• organise broker reviews, reverse broker reviews and client events end to end (planning, materials, logistics and actions)
• generate actionable client intelligence using advanced analytics and emerging AI tools; contribute to the design, testing and rollout of Sales AI capabilities
• produce concise, senior ready materials—briefings, performance reports and presentations that are decision oriented and easy to consume
• help build AI products that embed proactive insights, automation and decision support directly into sales workflows

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nell'ambito del Global Markets Client Office, contribuirai a plasmare e fornire la nostra strategia clienti in tutta la Global Markets Distribution, generando ricavi in uscita, vincendo quote di mercato e migliorando l'esperienza del cliente. Potrai agire come un connettore centrale tra i clienti e l'azienda, assicurando che portiamo la piattaforma UBS completa ai clienti senza silo bias. Metterete il cliente al centro del processo decisionale: identificare la parte delle lacune del portafoglio, privilegiare le giuste opportunità, e trasformare la comprensione in risultati commerciali misurabili. Potrai lavorare all'intersezione di dati, AI, vendite, trading e senior management, traducendo analisi in azione attraverso forum disciplinati, campagne e migliori in esecuzione di classe. Informare. Attiva. Eseguite. In questo ruolo, voi:
• guidare campagne client di asset cross e iniziative regionali per i clienti prioritari: opportunità sul posto, coordinare l'esecuzione e tracciare i risultati
• fornire analisi chiare e su larga scala sulle lacune del portafoglio, le prestazioni della campagna e le tendenze tematiche per informare la strategia e migliorare i risultati
• agire come la voce del cliente eseguendo le recensioni e i forum dei clienti interni strutturati con Sales & Trading e le parti interessate senior, catturando intuizioni, accettando azioni e assicurandosi di seguire attraverso
• supporta i principali client che vengono forniti attraverso la gestione del conto (ferma all'impegno costante, nuovo PM onboard, discussioni strategiche, escalation e connettività continua)
• organizzare recensioni di broker, recensioni di broker inversa e eventi cliente finiscono per finire (pianificazione, materiali, logistica e azioni)
• generare un'intelligenza client attiva utilizzando strumenti avanzati di analisi e di intelligenza artificiale emergenti; contribuire alla progettazione, alla sperimentazione e all'implementazione delle capacità di Sales AI
• produrre materiali concisi, senior ready—briefings, report di performance e presentazioni che sono orientate alle decisioni e facili da consumare
• contribuire a costruire prodotti AI che incorporano intuizioni proattive, automazione e supporto decisionale direttamente nei flussi di lavoro di vendita

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Dans le cadre de Global Markets Client Office, vous aiderez à façonner et à mettre en œuvre notre stratégie client dans l'ensemble de Global Markets Distribution, ce qui permettra d'obtenir des résultats supérieurs aux attentes, de gagner des parts de marché et d'améliorer l'expérience client. Vous agirez comme un connecteur central entre les clients et l'entreprise, assurant que nous apportons la plateforme complète UBS aux clients sans biais silo. Vous placerez le client au centre de la prise de décision : identifier la part des lacunes du portefeuille, hiérarchiser les bonnes occasions et transformer l'information en résultats commerciaux mesurables. Vous travaillerez à l'intersection des données, de l'IA, des ventes, du trading et de la haute direction, transformant l'analyse en action à travers des forums disciplinés, des campagnes et la meilleure exécution de classe. Informez. Activer. Exécutez. Dans ce rôle, vous :
• mener des campagnes inter-actifs et des initiatives régionales pour les clients prioritaires – opportunités ponctuelles, coordonner l'exécution et suivre les résultats
• Fournir des analyses claires et à grande échelle sur les lacunes du portefeuille, les résultats de la campagne et les tendances thématiques pour éclairer la stratégie et améliorer les résultats
• agir en tant que voix du client en organisant des revues et des forums internes structurés avec Sales & Trading et des parties prenantes de haut niveau – capter les idées, convenir des actions et assurer le suivi
• soutenir les principaux produits livrables des clients dans l'ensemble de la gestion des comptes (engagement ferme, nouvelles PM à bord, discussions stratégiques, escalades et connectivité continue)
• organiser les examens des courtiers, les examens des courtiers inversés et les événements clients fin à fin (planification, matériaux, logistique et actions)
• générer des informations clients exploitables à l'aide d'analyses avancées et d'outils d'IA émergents; contribuer à la conception, à l'essai et au déploiement des capacités d'IA de vente
• produire des documents concis, prêts à l'emploi, des comptes rendus, des rapports sur le rendement et des présentations qui soient axés sur les décisions et faciles à consommer;
• aider à construire des produits d'IA qui intègrent directement des informations proactives, l'automatisation et le soutien à la décision dans les flux de ventes

jobs.description:
Do you have the knowledge and experience to drive the business (development) with our Greater China client base? Do you have a track record of successfully managing client relationships? Are you able to create collaborative solutions in challenging and complex situations?

If so, we are looking for a strong candidate to join our Institutional Client Coverage team in HK to lead and grow our institutional asset management business in Greater China, very much as a player / coach.

You will lead and work closely with the incumbent Client Relationship Managers in our Greater China Institutional business.
The role will focus on shaping the business strategy for Greater China and growing our institutional business in the region across the UBS AM capability set. This will be done in conjunction with the incumbents. You (and your team) will be accountable for the delivery of agreed business targets and maximise (new) client mandates by leveraging industry knowledge, internal and external contacts and relationships.

• a key role in shaping our strategy for Greater China

• increase corporate & market awareness of the Greater China business, including the promotion of UBS AM at key events and roadshows as required
• contribute strongly to the team’s prospecting activity as a player. Leverage existing and new relationships to grow / diversify our book and achieve growth ambitions for the business
• work closely with the investment teams in both public and private markets, and Partnership Solutions and represent UBS Asset Management and UBS Group as such to organisations across the region
• management of the new business pipeline with the team and delivery of a thorough and organised process to ensure delivery of high quality & timely RfPs; pre pitch intelligence, internal preparation and briefings
• work closely across the firm, leveraging our capabilities in global markets, global banking and wealth management to ensure we deliver OneUBS to our clients

jobs.title: Global Markets - Electronic - Principal - Trader
jobs.description:
A CRB Quant Trader is responsible for developing quantitative models and managing the systematic execution of trades and orders on a principal basis.
The role focuses on generating revenue, providing liquidity to clients, and supporting client needs through disciplined risk and capital management.

Key Responsibilities:
• Generate revenue through development and timely/accurate execution and booking of trades/orders on a principal basis (generating P&L)
• Proactively keep abreast of market developments and trading opportunities; have a strong understanding of financial markets, instruments, and strategies
• Facilitate client order flow by providing liquidity via proprietary inventory (utilizing the firm’s capital) or accessing third party external offerings

• Adhere to all applicable regulations and internal policies including but not limited to quality of execution (example: best execution), trading activities (example: Volcker), pricing, hedging, trading-limits and compliance policies
• Manage broad range of risks, including but not limited to trading risk, execution risk, operational risk, compliance risk and conduct risk etc., evaluating options and making decisions
• Follow, adhere to and promote the UBS principles and behaviours acting with integrity, due skill, care, and diligence always
• Ensure escalation and disclosure of any information of which applicable regulators would reasonably expect notice
• Observe proper standards of market conduct while paying due regard to interests of customers and treating them fairly
• Where supervising other members of staff, ensure adherence to applicable regulations and internal policies via effective supervision and oversight with reference to the Principles of Good Supervision

Key Deliverables:
• Revenue generation (trading P&L, commissions, sales credits) and growing client business by provision of liquidity
• Strong contributions towards development of regional/global models driving the CRB business
• Adherence to regulations, compliance policies, desk policies, and guidelines as applicable to each market
• Risk management
• Conduct in accordance with UBS principles and behaviours along with regulatory expectations including escalation and disclosure of relevant issues

descriptionByLocale.it:
Un CRB Quant Trader è responsabile dello sviluppo di modelli quantitativi e della gestione dell'esecuzione sistematica di scambi e ordini su base principale. Il ruolo si concentra sulla generazione di ricavi, fornendo liquidità ai clienti, e supportando le esigenze dei clienti attraverso il rischio disciplinato e la gestione dei capitali. Responsabilità chiave:
• Generare entrate attraverso lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione tempestiva/accurata e la prenotazione di scambi/ordini su base principale (generando P&L)
• Tenere attivo il controllo degli sviluppi del mercato e delle opportunità di trading; avere una forte comprensione dei mercati finanziari, degli strumenti e delle strategie
• Facilitare il flusso dell’ordine del cliente fornendo liquidità tramite inventario proprietario (utilizzando il capitale dell’azienda) o accedendo a offerte esterne di terzi
• Adeguarsi a tutte le normative e politiche interne applicabili, tra cui ma non limitata alla qualità dell'esecuzione (esempio: migliore esecuzione), attività di trading (esempio: Volcker), prezzi, hedging, trading-limits e politiche di conformità
• Gestire una vasta gamma di rischi, inclusi ma non limitati al rischio di trading, al rischio di esecuzione, al rischio operativo, al rischio di conformità e al rischio di condotta ecc., valutare le opzioni e prendere decisioni
• Seguire, rispettare e promuovere i principi e comportamenti UBS che agiscono con integrità, dovuta abilità, cura e diligenza sempre
• Assicurare l'escalation e la divulgazione di qualsiasi informazione di cui i regolatori applicabili si aspetterebbero ragionevolmente
• Osservare gli standard adeguati di condotta di mercato, pagando a causa degli interessi dei clienti e trattandoli in modo equo
• Nel caso di supervisione di altri membri del personale, garantire l'aderenza alle normative e alle politiche interne applicabili tramite un'efficace supervisione e supervisione con riferimento ai principi di buona vigilanza Consegna chiavi:
• Generazione delle entrate (trading P&L, commissioni, crediti di vendita) e crescente business dei clienti con la liquidità
• Forte contributo allo sviluppo di modelli regionali/globali che guidano il business CRB
• osservanza di regolamenti, politiche di conformità, politiche di scrivania e linee guida applicabili a ciascun mercato
• Gestione del rischio
• Condurre in conformità con i principi e i comportamenti UBS insieme alle aspettative normative, tra cui l'escalation e la divulgazione di questioni rilevanti

Ein CRB Quant Trader ist für die Entwicklung von quantitativen Modellen verantwortlich und verwaltet die systematische Ausführung von Handel und Aufträgen grundsätzlich. Die Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Erzeugung von Einnahmen, die Bereitstellung von Liquidität für Kunden und die Unterstützung von Kundenbedürfnissen durch diszipliniertes Risiko und Kapitalmanagement. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:
• Umsatzermittlung durch Entwicklung und rechtzeitige/genaue Ausführung und Buchung von Waren/Aufträgen auf einer Hauptbasis (Erzeugung von P&L)
• Proaktiv bleiben Marktentwicklungen und Trading-Möglichkeiten; haben ein starkes Verständnis der Finanzmärkte, Instrumente und Strategien
• Erleichterung des Kundenauftragsdurchflusses durch Bereitstellung von Liquidität über proprietäre Inventar (unter Nutzung des Unternehmenskapitals) oder Zugang zu externen Angeboten Dritter
• Bewahren Sie sich an alle geltenden Vorschriften und internen Richtlinien, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf die Qualität der Ausführung (Beispiel: beste Ausführung), Handelsaktivitäten (Beispiel: Volcker), Preis-, Sicherungs-, Handels- und Compliance-Politiken
• Verwalten eines breiten Spektrums von Risiken, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Handelsrisiko, Ausführungsrisiko, operationelles Risiko, Compliance-Risiko und Verhaltensrisiko usw., Bewertungsoptionen und Entscheidungen
• Befolgen, betreuen und fördern die UBS-Prinzipien und Verhaltensweisen, die mit Integrität, Due Skill, Sorgfalt und Sorgfalt handeln, immer
• Sicherstellung der Eskalation und Offenlegung von Informationen, von denen die anwendbaren Regulierungsbehörden vernünftigerweise eine Mitteilung erwarten würden
• Beobachten Sie die richtigen Standards des Marktverhaltens und zahlen Sie gebührend die Interessen der Kunden und behandeln sie fair
• Bei der Betreuung anderer Mitarbeiter sorgen die Einhaltung der geltenden Vorschriften und der internen Politiken durch eine wirksame Aufsicht und Aufsicht unter Bezugnahme auf die Grundsätze der Guten Aufsicht Schlüssellieferungen:
• Umsatzerzeugung (Handel mit P&L, Provisionen, Verkaufskrediten) und wachsendes Kundengeschäft durch Bereitstellung von Liquidität
• Starke Beiträge zur Entwicklung regionaler/globaler Modelle, die das CRB-Geschäft vorantreiben
• Einhaltung von Vorschriften, Compliance-Richtlinien, Schreibtischrichtlinien und Richtlinien für jeden Markt
• Risikomanagement
• Verhalten nach UBS-Grundsätzen und Verhaltensweisen sowie regulatorische Erwartungen einschließlich Eskalation und Offenlegung relevanter Fragen

Le rôle consiste à générer des revenus, à fournir des liquidités aux clients et à répondre aux besoins des clients par une gestion rigoureuse du risque et du capital. Principales responsabilités :
• Générer des recettes grâce au développement, à l'exécution et à la réservation en temps opportun et précis des transactions/commandes sur une base principale (production de P&L)
• Se tenir au courant de l'évolution des marchés et des débouchés commerciaux; avoir une bonne compréhension des marchés financiers, des instruments et des stratégies

• Adhérer à tous les règlements et politiques internes applicables, y compris, sans s'y limiter, la qualité de l'exécution (exemple: meilleure exécution), les activités commerciales (exemple: Volcker), la tarification, la couverture, les limites commerciales et les politiques de conformité
• Gérer un large éventail de risques, notamment le risque de négociation, le risque d'exécution, le risque opérationnel, le risque de conformité et le risque de conduite, etc., évaluer les options et prendre des décisions
• Suivre, respecter et promouvoir les principes et comportements de l'UBS agissant avec intégrité, compétence, soin et diligence

• Respecter les normes de conduite du marché tout en tenant dûment compte des intérêts des clients et en les traitant équitablement
• Lorsqu'il supervise d'autres membres du personnel, veiller au respect des règlements et des politiques internes applicables par le biais d'une supervision et d'un contrôle efficaces eu égard aux principes de bonne surveillance Principaux produits livrables :

• Respect des règlements, des politiques de conformité, des politiques administratives et des lignes directrices applicables à chaque marché
• Gestion des risques
• Respecter les principes et les comportements de l'UBS ainsi que les attentes réglementaires, y compris l'escalade et la divulgation des questions pertinentes

jobs.description:
In this role, you will help oversee risk across the lending portfolio and support the day to day management of client exposures. Your responsibilities will include:

- perform holistic analysis of loan and derivative exposures which requires understanding of collateral, derivative products, risk methodologies and stress test reports
- identifying potential credit and derivatives related risks and escalating observations to senior stakeholders in a timely manner
- assisting with discussions relating to derivatives such as margin calibration, liquidity thresholds, etc.
- supporting the setup and monitoring of financial conditions and covenants for the lending transactions of some of UBS’ most sophisticated wealth management clients
- contributing to risk mitigation and remediation discussions for individual transactions and portfolios
- utilising AI‑enabled analytics to provide portfolio insights, risk summaries and ad-hoc analyses for management internal stakeholders.

jobs.title: Lombard and Mortgage Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you comercially driven, client-focused, and energized by closing deals? Do you enjoy structuring lending solutions and partnering closely with Client Advisors to grow revenue? We are looking for a Lombard and Mortgage Lending Specialist to:

- actively originate and drive Lombard and mortgage lending opportunities, partnering with Client Advisors from initial client discussions through to deal execution and closure
- provide subject matter expertise in residential mortgage lending, applying a strong understanding of the regulatory framework to ensure transactions comply with local regulations and internal credit policies.
- act as deal captain for complex lending transactions, structuring appropriate client solutions, assessing risks and mitigants, and preparing high‑quality credit submissions
- promote the suitable and sustainable use of lending solutions to Client Advisors, clients, and internal stakeholders
- drive sales momentum and conversion by identifying lending opportunities within existing and new client relationships
- provide guidance on pricing and structuring for complex lending transactions, applying sound commercial judgement
- contribute to asset growth and loan interest income through proactive marketing efforts and participation in client meetings
- build and maintain strong internal partnerships by continuously coaching Client Advisors and collaborating with Credit Risk Control and Investment Product teams
- continuously improve our lending and deposit offerings to better meet evolving client needs

Sei guidato comercialmente, focalizzato sul cliente, ed energizzato chiudendo le offerte? Ti piace strutturare soluzioni di prestito e collaborare a stretto contatto con i Client Advisor per aumentare i ricavi? Stiamo cercando uno specialista di prestiti lombardo e mortgage a:

- originare e guidare attivamente opportunità di prestito lombardo e mutuo, collaborando con i Client Advisors dalle discussioni iniziali del cliente attraverso per affrontare l'esecuzione e la chiusura

- promuovere l'uso adeguato e sostenibile delle soluzioni di prestito a consulenti, clienti e stakeholder interni
- impulso di vendita e conversione, identificando le opportunità di prestito all'interno delle relazioni esistenti e dei nuovi clienti
- fornire indicazioni sui prezzi e sulla strutturazione per operazioni di prestito complesse, applicando un giudizio commerciale valido
- contribuire alla crescita degli asset e al reddito degli interessi dei prestiti attraverso gli sforzi di marketing proattivo e la partecipazione alle riunioni dei clienti
- costruire e mantenere forti partnership interne allenando continuamente i Client Advisors e collaborando con i team di Credit Risk Control e Investment Product
- migliorare continuamente le nostre offerte di prestito e deposito per soddisfare meglio le esigenze dei clienti in evoluzione

Sind Sie Comercial-getrieben, Client-fokussiert und durch Abschluss-Angebote aktiviert? Genießen Sie die Strukturierung von Kreditlösungen und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kundenberatern, um Umsatz zu steigern? Wir suchen einen Lombard und Mortgage Lending Spezialist für:

- aktiv starten und fahren Lombard und Hypothekenkredite Möglichkeiten, die Zusammenarbeit mit Kundenberatern von ersten Kundengesprächen bis hin zur Abwicklung und Schließung
- Bereitstellung von Fachkenntnissen in der Hypothekenkreditierung von Wohnimmobilien, die Anwendung eines starken Verständnisses des Regulierungsrahmens, um sicherzustellen, dass Transaktionen den lokalen Vorschriften und internen Kreditpolitiken entsprechen.
- fungieren als Dealkapitän für komplexe Kredittransaktionen, die Strukturierung geeigneter Kundenlösungen, die Bewertung von Risiken und Mitiganten und die Vorbereitung qualitativ hochwertiger Kreditbeiträge
- die angemessene und nachhaltige Nutzung von Kreditlösungen für Kundenberater, Kunden und interne Interessenvertreter fördern
- Steigerung der Verkaufsdynamik und Umstellung durch die Identifizierung von Kreditmöglichkeiten innerhalb bestehender und neuer Kundenbeziehungen
- Leitlinien für die Preisgestaltung und -strukturierung bei komplexen Kreditgeschäften zur Anwendung einer soliden wirtschaftlichen Beurteilung
- Beitrag zu Vermögenswachstum und Kreditzinserträgen durch proaktive Marketingbemühungen und Beteiligung an Kundensitzungen
- Aufbau und Pflege starker interner Partnerschaften durch ständiges Coaching von Kundenberatern und Zusammenarbeit mit Credit Risk Control and Investment Product Teams
- kontinuierlich verbessern unsere Kredit- und Einzahlungsangebote, um den wachsenden Kundenbedürfnissen besser gerecht zu werden

Êtes-vous dirigé par le client et énergisé par la conclusion de contrats ? Vous aimez structurer les solutions de prêt et vous associer étroitement avec les conseillers clients pour augmenter les revenus? Nous recherchons un spécialiste des prêts hypothécaires et lombard pour :

- proviennent activement et stimulent les opportunités de prêt hypothécaire et lombard, en partenariat avec les conseillers clients des discussions initiales des clients jusqu'à l'exécution et la clôture des contrats
- fournir une expertise en matière de prêts hypothécaires résidentiels, en appliquant une bonne compréhension du cadre réglementaire pour assurer que les transactions sont conformes aux règlements locaux et aux politiques internes de crédit.
- agir à titre de capitaine de transaction pour des opérations de prêt complexes, structurer les solutions client appropriées, évaluer les risques et les mitigants, et préparer des soumissions de crédit de haute qualité
- promouvoir l'utilisation appropriée et durable des solutions de prêt auprès des conseillers clients, des clients et des intervenants internes
- stimuler la dynamique des ventes et la conversion en identifiant les possibilités de prêt dans les relations client existantes et nouvelles
- fournir des orientations sur la tarification et la structuration pour les opérations de prêt complexes, en appliquant un jugement commercial solide
- contribuer à la croissance des actifs et aux intérêts sur les prêts grâce à des efforts de marketing proactifs et à la participation aux réunions de clients
- établir et maintenir des partenariats internes solides en formant continuellement les conseillers clients et en collaborant avec les équipes de contrôle des risques de crédit et de produits d'investissement
- améliorer continuellement nos offres de prêts et de dépôts pour mieux répondre aux besoins changeants des clients

jobs.description:
Join us at UBS Group as Regulatory Reporting and Fund Administration Specialist in the Gestora from which you will be supporting the team in Madrid office within the Global Wealth Management division.

You will support to the team in tasks such as:
• Prepare and submit periodic regulatory statements and reports required by the CNMV and other official bodies (including, among others: confidential regulatory statements, statistical reports, AIFMD/UCITS reporting, Bank of Spain).
• Coordinate data collection with internal areas (portfolio management, risk, accounting, depositary, back office).
• Ensure consistency, completeness, and traceability of reported information.
• Manage corrections, clarifications, and information requests from the CNMV.
• Monitor regulatory changes affecting SGIIC regulatory reporting and support related IT adaptations.
• Participate in the continuous improvement of reporting processes and tools.
• Invoice management and control, including review, posting, and payment follow-up.
• Bank reconciliations and review of account movements of Collective Investment Institutions
(CIIs).
• Operational management of transfers, subscriptions, and redemptions of CIIs, in coordination with the depositary and other involved parties.
• Monitoring operational incidents and resolving discrepancies.

jobs.description:
Are you motivated to work in fast-paced environment? You will work in the Presentations Team within our Investment Banking division, creating high-quality presentation materials for clients using PowerPoint.

グローバルバンキング部門（投資銀行本部）のプレゼンテーションチームにて、資料作成・改善を担うパワーポイントデザイナーを募集しています。

Main responsibilities:
• Create PowerPoint presentations and pitchbooks for clients, following UBS’s official style guidelines
• Work closely with bankers in Japan and sometimes with teams overseas
• Learn new skills and contribute to successful pitch materials

職務内容

クライアント向けの商談や提案に使用される資料の作成・ブラッシュアップをご担当いただきます。複雑な情報を整理し、分かりやすく視覚的に伝わるスライドへと仕上げていただきます。
デザインの観点から情報の伝え方を改善するための提案にも関わっていただきます。

主な業務内容：
- プレゼンテーション資料およびピッチ資料の作成・ブラッシュアップ
- 情報を分かりやすく伝えるためのレイアウト、チャート、スライドの設計
- 既存資料の改善・磨き込み（可読性・一貫性・全体品質の向上）
- 社内関係者と連携し、目的や要件を理解した上で資料に反映

jobs.title: Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
Are you curious about how a global bank manages compliance, operational risk, and regulatory obligations? Do you enjoy working with data, processes, and controls while learning how risk frameworks support business decisions? Are you interested in developing a strong foundation in risk and governance?

We’re looking for a Junior Talent Program (JTP) Intern to:

Support compliance & operational risk control (C&ORC) activities across GCORC teams.

Assist in maintaining and documenting risk, control, and governance frameworks in line with internal policies and regulatory standards.

Help with data analysis, reporting, and monitoring activities related to non‑financial risk.

Contribute to the preparation of materials, dashboards, and documentation used to support risk management and oversight.

jobs.title: Investment Advisor
jobs.description:
Your role :
Do you have the perfect pitch? Do you follow the markets, even in your spare time?

We’re looking for an investment advisor to:
• Work closely with the Premium Advisory Specialist team in Taiwan & APAC
• Act as the dedicated portfolio specialist for clients with UBS Advice Premium Mandates, providing comprehensive investment advice across various asset classes, guided by Chief Investment Office's Strategic Asset Allocation and Tactical Asset Allocation
• Deliver customized investment proposals directly to clients to match their investment objectives, risk appetite and preferences
• Perform trade executions and regular systematic portfolio reviews to keep clients' investments on track and identify potential risks
• Provide advice based on UBS investment views (through Chief Investment Office) that aims to maximize the client's portfolio performance while being consistent with the client's objectives
• Monitor client portfolios on a regular basis in close co-operation with the client (with regular reviews of client risk profile and investment objectives)
• Pro-actively contact clients with meaningful portfolio updates and provides investment recommendations within a portfolio context and a disciplined / risk-controlled framework
• Responsible for timely and adequate execution, confirmation and supervision of orders given by the client
• Follow developments in the financial markets to maintain an understanding of both current and anticipated trends across relevant markets and asset classes

We are looking for an Analyst responsible for ensuring the timely and accurate processing of transactions and events. This includes booking, pre matching, settlement, filing, archiving, and handling internal and external queries.
The role also covers transaction and position reconciliations and may include cash management, payment activities, and the resolution of client service issues.

Key Responsibilities/ As an Analyst, you will be expected to:
• Execute assigned processes and controls in a timely, accurate, and complete manner
• Perform preparatory work, transaction processing, control checks, and reconciliation tasks
• Ensure full compliance with legal, regulatory, and statutory requirements, as well as internal policies and contractual obligations
• Identify, understand, and manage the risks associated with your business and function
• Collaborate across teams and functions to deliver the most effective solutions and courses of action
